field_docs.seed: Random seed for spawn positions and roaming headings (same seed = same horde)
field_docs.flow_cell_size: Edge in metres of the shared flow-field grid
field_docs.field_recompute_interval: Minimum seconds between flow-field recomputes (the field is rebuilt on a worker thread)
field_docs.obstacle_margin: Metres buildings are grown by when blocking the flow-field grid
field_docs.zombie: hit_points: shots needed scale with this; roam_speed/alert_speed/chase_speed: metres per second when wandering / following noise / chasing a seen soldier; sight_range: metres a zombie sees a soldier (needs line of sight); contact_range: metres at which it bites; attack_damage/attack_interval: damage per bite and seconds between bites; perception_interval: seconds between sight checks per zombie; roam_turn_min/roam_turn_max: seconds between heading changes of a roaming zombie
field_docs.attractors: memory_seconds: how long a noise keeps drawing the horde; merge_distance: noises closer than this share one attractor (metres); max_count: whole number >= 1, attractors kept at once; loudness_weight: path-length handicap in metres per metre of radius a quieter noise has versus the loudest (higher = loudest wins from further away)
field_docs.spawn: safe_radius: metres around player spawn points and soldiers kept free of newly spawned zombies; attempts: whole number >= 1, random positions tried per zombie
field_docs.heat_map: Debug heat-map overlay: cell_size in metres; refresh_interval seconds; full_density: zombies per cell that get color_high; color_low/color_high RGBA 0..1
field_docs.separation: Crowd spacing via a spatial hash: radius: metres within which zombies push apart (also the hash cell size); strength: push speed in metres per second at full overlap; max_neighbors: whole number, most neighbours read per zombie per step (caps cost in dense crowds); update_interval: seconds between push recomputes per zombie (staggered across zombies; the hash is rebuilt at the same rate)
field_docs.last_seen: A chasing zombie that loses sight of its soldier heads for where it last saw it: pull_strength: loudness in metres of that quiet attractor (low = only pulls nearby zombies already following the field); lifetime: seconds it lasts; arrive_distance: metres from the spot at which the zombie gives up and goes home
